story.title: A Day, Considered
story.intro: One day, five moods. Follow the light from the first street of the morning to the last warm room of the evening.

chapters.title: Morning
chapters.line: The city before it fills. Soft colour, open streets, the day still undecided.

chapters.title: In Transit
chapters.line: Crossings, signals, a suitcase in tow. Clothes that keep their composure in motion.

chapters.title: A Pause
chapters.line: A shopfront, a ledge, a passing tram. The quiet minutes where style is most personal.

chapters.title: Soft Light
chapters.line: Satin, florals and water-bright afternoons. Everything a little lighter, a little slower.

chapters.title: Evening
chapters.line: Lamplight, old wood, woven detail. The day closes with a little more presence.

signature.title: The Lilac Print
signature.text: A black blouse, cut loose through the sleeve, over lilac floral wide-leg trousers. Our most-asked-about look, shown from every side.

craft.label: The Print
craft.text: Tonal lilac florals, scaled to move with a wide leg.

craft.label: The Weave
craft.text: A woven bodice framed in sheer lace, made for evening.

craft.label: The Texture
craft.text: A textured check against a smooth, sculpted line.

craft.label: The Sheen
craft.text: Soft satin ruffles that catch the daylight.

selected.title: Selected Frames
selected.line: A few pieces we keep returning to. The full collection waits at the end.
